text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces errors. Productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees work faster and focus on important tasks. Human-AI collaboration is also becoming common, as people work with AI systems to solve problems and make better decisions. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones will appear, and workers will need new skills. For this reason, learning to use AI tools and adapting to change is essential for success in the modern workplace.
